subject: chore(agent): remove dead vendored capture-commit.py copy
body:
Nothing invokes .agent/scripts/memory/capture-commit.py — post-commit.sh
calls harness-core's copy directly by absolute path, and bootstrap-agent-project
no longer seeds this file for new repos. It was stale, unreferenced leftover
from an earlier harness design.
